lines.text: This quiet bureaucrat created the modern financial world.
And he was secretly working for Joseph Stalin.
His name was Harry Dexter White, top economist at the U.S. Treasury.
In nineteen forty-four, world leaders met at Bretton Woods to rebuild global trade.
British genius John Maynard Keynes brought his own grand vision.
Look at White pointing to his charts: he completely outmaneuvered Keynes.
White dethroned the British Pound and crowned the U.S. Dollar world king.
He founded the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank.
What Washington didn't know was his Soviet codename: Jurist.
For years, White funneled confidential Treasury intelligence straight to Moscow.
Exposed in nineteen forty-eight, he died of a heart attack three days after testifying.
Leaving behind the capitalist empire he built... and betrayed.
